title: Raise the maximum page size from 25 to 100
bug: The cap is removed entirely: `?limit=1000` returns everything.

findings.label: intended
findings.why: The PR raises the max page size from 25 to 100 by removing the clamp `if limit > max_limit: limit = max_limit` in api/decorators.py, so a request with `?limit=50` now returns 50 items instead of being capped at 25.

doppel.summary: The change is intended: removing the limit clamp allows clients to fetch up to 100 items per page as described.
